blogs.title: Spin the Lens: Introducing Orthogonal Finetuning – The Secret to Controlling Diffusion Models
blogs.description: Explore how orthogonal transforms give diffusion models a new kind of tunability without losing their breathtaking generative power. We break down hyperspherical energy at an intuitive level and explain why rotating neurons (but not shaking them) preserves pre‑trained semantics, all while keeping the math simple for non‑experts.

blogs.title: "I Came From Here": Subject‑Driven Generation Made Simple With OFT
blogs.description: Discover how only a handful of personal photos can turn a black‑box diffusion model into a faithful portrait generator. This post walks through the subject‑driven pipeline, comparing popular methods like DreamBooth and LoRA against OFT, highlighting fast convergence, stable identity preservation, and why little data suffices.

blogs.title: "Tell Me What I Want" – Controllable Image Generation With OFT
blogs.description: Learn how adding simple signals—edges, segmentation maps or facial landmarks—enables precise image control on top of big diffusion models. We present a clear explanation of the new control consistency metric, show why OFT outperforms ControlNet and T2I‑Adapter on real datasets, and translate these gains into everyday creative workflow tips.

blogs.title: "Large Model Meets Tiny Footprint": Why Orthogonal Matrices Beat Low‑Rank LoRA
blogs.description: "You’re not training from scratch," you’ll hear—but your model still needs direction! This article demystifies block‑diagonal orthogonal transformations versus LoRA’s low‑rank updates, showing how fewer parameters lead to sparser learning spaces without sacrificing performance or inference speed.

blogs.title: "Beyond Spin": Open Questions & Future Directions in Orthogonal Finetuning
blogs.description: "Is there more you can do?" We look ahead at scalability barriers posed by matrix inversions, potential compositional gains from chaining orthogonal tweaks across tasks, and emerging research on better parameter efficiency—all while inviting hobbyists and researchers alike to experiment with these fresh ideas.
